slices.focus: Dispatch board pilot on two routes to standardize handoffs and delays.
slices.summary: Jae-hyun launches a limited pilot of a color-coded dispatch board on two short-haul routes, splitting delays into weather, paperwork, and crew categories. Built from January's incident file and real captain call sheets, the board aims to make handoff failures legible in real time rather than reconstructable after arguments.

slices.focus: Jae-hyun discovers interest in Busan harbor history and port nonfiction.
slices.summary: During a lighter weekend, Jae-hyun watches Busan harbor history videos sent by friend Ji-hoon and realizes he actively seeks Korean port-history content, especially about Busan. He recognizes a durable preference for long-form documentary and lecture material over novels, with the subject matter connecting work, city, and genuine curiosity.

Transitioning from documentaries to related books
Balancing this niche interest with work obligations
